note_sections.t: Routine monitoring after mpMRI completion and detection of an upward PSA trajectory.

He walks twenty minutes daily and ceased tobacco use completely in 2022, concluding a thirty-one pack-year smoking history. His pharmacological profile consists of amlodipine, metoprolol, aspirin 80 mg, atorvastatin, and tamsulosin, the latter addressing benign prostatic hyperplasia that yields minor bothersome symptoms (IPSS 7/35). Underlying hypertension and coronary artery disease remain stable. No prior biopsy history has been recorded. Recent outpatient visits covered audiological screening, pulmonary function tests for established COPD, and dermatological evaluation for actinic keratosis. A cholecystectomy performed during his forties represents his only surgical history. He reports no acute complaints or systemic symptoms beyond these managed chronic conditions.

DRE reveals a uniformly smooth prostatic contour, free of nodularity or asymmetrical firmness. Systemic assessment shows no acute abnormalities, with cardiovascular and pulmonary signs aligning with his established medical background.
